en_US.title: Aegir Moon Ladder
en_US.scanner: Moon ladder chart. HECTON-8 is one working hazard in a moving system, not an isolated level.
en_US.field_note: Skarn burns, Vela sheds ice, Anvil feeds metal, Kestrel cuts relays, HECTON-8 drowns.

en_US.external_site: Aegir Moon Ladder gives the game a usable local astronomy layer. Other moons explain route windows, dead claims, salvage rumors and why Black Keel cannot always answer from a convenient orbit.
